findings.highlight: Mordred was created as a clone, and served the king without knowing who his father was. Mordred sought an opportunity to take the throne for himself, ultimately going so far as to organize a revolt.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の分身として作られたモードレッドは、父を明かせぬ騎士として王に仕え、その座を簒奪する日を待ち、ついに反旗を翻した。
findings.governingReading: Mordred serves as a knight who cannot reveal his father, waiting to usurp the throne.
findings.explanation: Unable to disclose his father becomes not knowing his father.

findings.highlight: She defeated many of the knights who used to serve her.
findings.evidenceJa: かつて従えていた騎士をことごとく斬り伏せ、
findings.governingReading: She cuts down all the former subjects encountered in this invasion.
findings.explanation: All opposing former knights cut down becomes many defeated.

findings.highlight: She was forced to punish the knights who once served her, and had to watch those knights who remained loyal to her die.
findings.evidenceJa: 臣下であった騎士を自らの手で処罰し、従ってくれた騎士たちを皆死なせ。
findings.governingReading: She punishes former subjects with her own hands and lets/causes all loyal followers to die.
findings.explanation: Her causing loyal knights’ deaths becomes having to watch them die.

findings.highlight: She used Excalibur. She must be running low on magical energy, since she probably healed herself too.
findings.evidenceJa: 今はエクスカリバーを使った後だ。自然治癒の為の魔力も不足しているのではないだろうか。
findings.governingReading: After Excalibur he wonders whether she lacks even the mana required for natural healing.
findings.explanation: Shortage of magic for healing becomes shortage because of healing.

findings.evidenceJa: 今は俺より、セイバーの方が辛いだろう」
findings.governingReading: He thinks she now has the greater burden and should rest instead of caring for him.
findings.explanation: Her suffering more than his becomes suffering too.

findings.highlight: "Hm? Does your wound still hurt? You fever does not seem to have gone down..."
findings.evidenceJa: 「？　シロウ、傷が痛むのですか？　また熱が出て来たようですが—」
findings.governingReading: The intended forms are your fever, all of a sudden, pushes it back, and she lies beside him.

findings.highlight: "Fine. I'm going to rest, so I want you to rest too, Saber. I won't be able to sleep, knowing you aren't resting.
findings.evidenceJa: 「わかったよ。俺もしっかりと休むから、セイバーもちゃんと休んでくれ。セイバーが休んでくれないと、俺も落ち着いて眠れない」
findings.governingReading: His rest reply closes before her reply; her farewell runs to its last clause; the beautiful reply closes before narration.
findings.explanation: Dialogue quotation marks are missing or prematurely closed.

findings.highlight: I regret not telling her to stay here and just take my futon while I use my arm as a pillow, but that would be too much for her.
findings.evidenceJa: あのまま枕頭にいて貰いたかった未練もあるが、それだとセイバーに負担を掛けてしまう。
findings.governingReading: 枕頭 means at his pillow/bedside: he wishes she had remained but that would burden her.
findings.explanation: Wanting her at his bedside becomes a futon-and-arm-pillow plan.

findings.highlight: Not only do we have to deal with Gilgamesh, but we also need to defeat Lancer and whoever his Master is.
findings.evidenceJa: ギルガメッシュだけでなく、まだランサーとそのマスターの正体も判っていない。
findings.governingReading: Beyond Gilgamesh, Lancer and his Master’s identities remain unresolved.
findings.explanation: Unresolved identities becomes enemies still needing defeat.

findings.highlight: I hold her so tight I might break her.
findings.evidenceJa: 折れそうなほど強く抱きしめても、その身体は抗わない。
findings.governingReading: Even when held almost hard enough to break, her body does not resist.
findings.explanation: The tight embrace loses her absence of physical resistance.

findings.highlight: I never fell in love. There was never someone I couldn't let go of.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺は何かを愛しいと。誰かを離したくないと、思う事さえなかったのか。
findings.governingReading: He wonders whether he had never even thought something dear or wanted not to lose someone.
findings.explanation: Never even cherishing something becomes never falling in romantic love.

findings.highlight: She's still tense, unsure of herself.
findings.evidenceJa: まだ、こうして抱かれる事を良しとしない硬さが残っている。
findings.governingReading: Her stiffness still does not approve of being embraced this way.
findings.explanation: Not accepting being held becomes unsure of herself.

findings.highlight: "I cannot reciprocate your feelings. As you cannot change, so there are things I cannot change about myself.
findings.evidenceJa: 「……貴方の気持ちには応えられない。貴方がその正しさを変えられないように、私にも変えられないものがある。
findings.governingReading: She compares her fixed commitments with his inability to change that rightness/conviction.
findings.explanation: His unchangeable sense of right becomes you cannot change.

findings.highlight: She bites her lip, trembling, as if confessing that what we did that night was not permitted.
findings.evidenceJa: この夜でさえ許されない事だと、唇を噛みながら、体を震わせながら、懺悔するように彼女は言った。
findings.governingReading: She speaks as if confessing that even this current night is impermissible, before the one-night wish is articulated.
findings.explanation: Even this night not permitted becomes what they did that night.

findings.highlight: Her hushed voice, asking for permission, falls silent.
findings.evidenceJa: 密やかな声が、許すように、押し止めた
findings.governingReading: Her hushed words, as if allowing, stop his attempted renewed embrace.
findings.explanation: A permitting voice stopping him becomes a permission-seeking voice falling silent.

findings.highlight: I don't know why but I find myself sitting on top of my futon.
findings.evidenceJa: 布団の上で、どうしてか正座で待った。
findings.governingReading: He inexplicably waits in seiza on the futon; later both kneel beside it.

findings.highlight: Even if I explain it to Saber, she wouldn't understand, but my mind's practically shorted out.
findings.evidenceJa: こんな事を言ってもセイバーに判る訳でもないのに、言わないと精神が焼き付いてしまって動かない。
findings.governingReading: Although she may not understand, he must say it or his mind will seize and stop.
findings.explanation: Speaking to avert mental seizure becomes almost already shorting out.

findings.highlight: I want to hear again why I desire her so much.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が彼女が欲しいと求めた、その答えを聞く為に。
findings.governingReading: He wants her answer to his asking for her.
findings.explanation: Her answer to his request becomes an explanation of his own desire.
